## Changes

**`codex-rs/core/src/config/mod.rs`**
1. Added `include_environment_context: bool` to the `Config` struct.
2. Added `include_environment_context: Option<bool>` to the `ConfigToml` struct.
3. In config loading, resolved the value with profile-takes-precedence semantics defaulting to `true`:
   ```rust
   let include_environment_context = config_profile
       .include_environment_context
       .or(cfg.include_environment_context)
       .unwrap_or(true);
   ```
4. Wired the resolved value into the constructed `Config`.

**`codex-rs/core/src/config/profile.rs`**
- Added `include_environment_context: Option<bool>` to `ConfigProfile` so profile-level overrides work (it's consumed first via `.or(...)`).

**`codex-rs/core/src/codex.rs`** (`build_initial_context`)
- Gated the `EnvironmentContext` push into `contextual_user_sections` behind `if turn_context.config.include_environment_context`, so no `<environment_context>` tag is added to the user message when disabled.

**`codex-rs/core/src/context_manager/updates.rs`** (`build_environment_update_item`)
- Added an early `return None` when `include_environment_context` is false, so the diff-based environment update emitted on later turns is also suppressed — matching the existing pattern used for `include_permissions_instructions`.

- `cargo build -p codex-core` succeeds with no errors.
